jobs.title: Operational Technology Engineer
jobs.description:
**Operational Technology Engineer**
===================================

Requisition ID: 19418
Location:
Zug, CH, 6300
Pay Type:
Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 48,000 employees in 45 attractive markets – across Europe, Latin America, Asia, Middle East \& Africa. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundations and flooring to roofing and walling – powered by premium brands including ECOPlanet, ECOPact, and ECOCycle®. Find out more at www.holcim.com


**WHO IS HOLCIM?**
  

As a global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions, Holcim is enabling greener cities, smarter infrastructure and improving living standards around the world. With sustainability at the core of our strategy, we are becoming a net\-zero company, with our people and communities at the heart of our success. We are driving circular construction as a world leader in recycling to build more with less. It’s all thanks to our 70,000 talented people around the world who are passionate about building progress for people and the planet through four business segments: Cement, Ready\-Mix Concrete, Aggregates and Solutions \& Products.


**WHO ARE HOLCIM PEOPLE**
  

Holcim people are passionate about finding better ways to build. They embrace innovation and improvement with a pioneering spirit. They work as trusted partners, creating better solutions and experiences for their customers, communities, and colleagues.


Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction with net sales of CHF 15\.7 billion in 2025, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 50 000 employees in 45 countries – across Europe, Latin America and Asia, Middle East \& Africa – and has been recognized as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundation and flooring to walling and roofing – powered by premium brands including ECOPact, ECOPlanet, ECOCycle, and Ytong.

  

**Role Overview**

  

The **Operational Technology Engineer** is a specialized strategic role focused on the design, deployment, standardisation, and governance of Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) \- internally identified as Technical Information Systems (TIS). Acting as the critical bridge between TIS, ICS and the ERP, this role ensures the integrity, cyber\-resilience and continuous availability of operational data across the global organization.  

  

  

  

This role requires an innovative engineer to drive automation and digital transformation by serving high\-fidelity data to advanced analytics, IIoT platforms, and optimization tools. The ideal candidate thrives in a high\-performance culture, demonstrates a strong commitment to operational sustainability, and acts as a catalyst for continuous learning and technology adoption.  

  

  

**Main Responsibilities**

  

The Operational Technology Engineer plays a critical role in standardizing and optimizing automation systems to capture, analyse, and leverage production data, driving operational efficiency across all industrial processes.  

  

  

**1\. Strategy \& Standardization**  

* Collaborate in define and implement corporate\-wide ICS/TIS standards to ensure global consistency in KPIs, reporting structures, and data architecture across 100\+ plants

* Align OT strategy in line with corporate guidance with business goals, identifying emerging technology needs and establishing multi\-year technical roadmaps.

* Drive innovation and industrial transformation: implement Plant of Tomorrow (PoT) solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.

* Train and mentor the OT plant teams: build high\-performing operational plant teams through training and development, focusing on ICS and TIS systems.

* Educate and advise plant OT related risks and opportunities

* Support the product roadmap for new functionalities and features within the PCS/MES ecosystem.

* Design and maintain robust interfaces between the shop floor (PCS/DCS), laboratory (LIMS), and business layers (SAP).

  

  

  

**2\. Global Deployment \& Operations**  

* Support the full lifecycle of ICS/MES deployments, from initial site assessment and vendor coordination to post\-go\-live support and version upgrades.

* Ensure reliability of the ICS/TIS environment, coordinating with IT and external vendors.

* Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot industrial data communication protocols and networking standards (e.g., Modbus, OPC UA/DA/HDA).

* Optimize production data streams to improve overall process efficiency and support decarbonization/sustainability goals.

  

  

**3\. Data Governance \& Security**  

* Uphold the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and confidentiality to support "Smart Operations" and advanced analytics.

* Collaborate with the Cybersecurity team to implement robust protective measures for OT data systems against evolving cyber threats.

* Maintain comprehensive documentation for data architecture and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  

  

**4\. Leadership \& Knowledge Management**  

* Design and execute global training programs to upskill plant\-level PCS, TIS, PIMS, and LIMS champions.

* Manage a centralized corporate knowledge base, including engineering standards, operational manuals and troubleshooting guides.

* Influence senior stakeholders and plant management to ensure buy\-in for digital initiatives and technical standards.

**5\. Collaboration \& Communication:**  

* Work cross\-functionally with Maintenance, Process/Production, Quality Control, Corporate IT, and PM\&E to ensure end\-to\-end system integration and alignment.

**6\. Operational Management**  

* Oversee site\-level OT performance, ensuring smooth, secure, and efficient multi\-plant operations. Implement and enforce cybersecurity measures: protect OT systems from cyber threats and vulnerabilities through OT cybersecurity controls.

  

  

**Your Profile**

  

**Level of education/qualifications normally required:**  

* MS or PhD in Electrical, Electronic, or Automation Engineering.

* (preferred) ISA/IEC 62443 OT cybersecurity certificate

  

  

**Experience**  

* 3 years’ experience as plant automation/systems engineer for process industry

* 3 years’ in managing industrial data systems (Historians, MES) and industrial networking.

* 3 years’ experience in cement (advantage)

  

  

**Technical / functional skills:**  

* Deep understanding of OT systems in the process industry: This includes industrial control systems, SCADA systems, distributed control systems (DCS), programmable logic controllers (PLCs), and manufacturing execution systems.

* Understanding of OT security threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigation strategies. Familiarity with security frameworks and standards like IEC 62443\.

* Knowledge of industrial networking protocols like Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC UA.

* Knowledge of cloud platforms and IoT technologies relevant to industrial environments, JavaScript and prototyping languages such as Python

* In\-depth understanding of continuous cement manufacturing processes, instrumentation, and sensor technologies.

.  

**Language skills:**  

* English (technical fluency critical)

  

* Spanish, German and French are an advantage

  

  

  

**Mobility requirements:**  

* 30% international traveling worldwide

  

  

**Benefits**


* Hybrid work contract
* Family Support: Subsidized child care and paid maternity/paternity leave
* Professional Growth: Company\-sponsored training and professional development.
* Discounts and Perks: Subsidized meals, exclusive discounts, and company gifts for special occasions.
* Long\-service awards
* Employee referral bonus
* Pension and Savings: Access to a comprehensive pension fund and an employee savings scheme.

*Holcim is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We support equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of race, national origin, gender, sexuality, disability, or age.*

  

*Important Notice: Holcim recruiters only contact candidates via official @\[holcim.com] email addresses. We do not use Gmail or any other non\-Holcim domains to conduct recruitment processes. Please verify the sender address before responding."*

  

Do you want to work in an international and dynamic working environment with attractive benefits? We are looking for colleagues to join our team to build progress for people and the planet.


Please submit your CV, a motivation letter and relevant documents with information on the career portal. No agencies can be considered.

The SY\-BI group in CERN's Accelerator Systems Department develops and operates the instruments used to observe particle beams and measure their key properties. These systems are essential to the reliable operation, optimisation, and future development of CERN's accelerator complex.


You will contribute to the development of next\-generation beam\-position monitoring systems for CERN's injector complex, including the pre\-accelerators and Antimatter Decelerator. You will work on innovative high\-speed data\-acquisition platforms combining fast digitisers with advanced System\-on\-Chip (SoC) technologies.


This role offers a hands\-on opportunity to work at the intersection of digital electronics, embedded systems, real\-time signal processing, and accelerator physics. It is particularly suited to people with an interest in FPGA or HDL development, high\-speed electronics, embedded software, digital signal processing, instrumentation, or experimental physics.

**Your responsibilities:**

* Develop, integrate and test FPGA gateware and embedded SoC firmware for a SoC device.
* Implement data acquisition and data processing logic and real\-time digital signal\-processing algorithms.
* Validate system performance in laboratory and accelerator environments.
* Perform data analysis in Python.
* Assist measurement campaigns in the accelerator complex.
* Collaborate with experienced engineers, physicists, and technicians from different teams across CERN.

* Experience in digital signal processing.
* Demonstrated experience with FPGA and SoC.

**Overview**  

Visual Studio Code is where millions of developers turn ideas into working software. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer in Zurich to help build its next generation of editing, development, and GitHub Copilot experiences.


You will help make complex developer workflows feel simple, from everyday coding and debugging to delegating work to AI. This is hands\-on product engineering in a large TypeScript and Rust codebase: you will shape a feature or technical area's direction, implement it, and keep improving it after release. We value engineers who care about how software feels, make sound decisions amid ambiguity, and learn from what they ship.

  

About the team


We work in the open, with direct feedback from developers and extension authors. You will collaborate with engineers, designers, researchers, and product teams across our team, GitHub, and Microsoft. We combine community feedback, research, experiments, and engineering judgment to decide what to build. Performance, accessibility, extensibility, security, and developer control are part of the product, not finishing touches.

  

Examples of work


The role spans core VS Code and Copilot; illustrative projects include:

* Improve navigation and editing in large repositories without slowing down startup or typing.
* Build a Copilot workflow that helps developers delegate a coding task, inspect the changes, and validate them using VS Code's review, testing, and debugging tools.
* Extend VS Code APIs so new capabilities work reliably with existing extensions and remote development environments.
* Refine our existing engineering process with custom tools fine\-tuned for throughput and quality.

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect, Scientific Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Agilent instruments produce the measurements behind pharmaceutical quality control, food and environmental testing, and research labs worldwide. That data sits in dozens of software products, and we are building a platform that lets our products, our customers' workflows, and AI agents find and use it wherever it lives.

  

We are hiring a data architect to own the discovery and access side of that platform: how scientific data is registered and found, and how it is composed and served. The platform architecture is established; the target state for discovery and access, and the path to it, are yours to define.

  

You work under the Lead Data Architect, who owns cross\-service standards and governance. Within your areas, the architecture decisions are yours; cross\-service decisions go to the Lead with evidence, options, and a recommendation.

  

This is an architecture role with hands\-on evidence: you decide the architecture for your areas, stay with engineering through implementation, and read the code, run the queries, and build the proof of concept when an argument needs one.

 **Your areas:**

* Data access. Your part of the federated GraphQL gateway, which the platform team owns how connected systems are represented on it, directly or through data services; the read layer that composes results across systems; and the application data services that expose access\-controlled views of scientific data to products, workflows, and AI consumers.
* Catalog and search. The catalog record model, how connected systems register their data and how that metadata is represented, search over it, and the path to richer indexes like vector and graph.

  

Access is the first\-year priority; catalog work runs alongside as the first connectors land. File management, metadata extraction, and semantic standards are owned by other architects on the team. The data is scientific data created by software products: results, methods, samples, files. ERP, CRM, and other enterprise business systems are out of scope.

 **What you will do:**

* Establish how the catalog and access paths behave today and define the target state: service boundaries, contracts, integration patterns, and the path between the two.
* Own the schemas and contracts your areas depend on: catalog records, subgraph boundaries, data service views, and versioned event schemas. Design them and make explicit which system is authoritative for each piece of information under the program's data governance rules, and version them so existing consumers keep working.
* Design the access paths AI agents use to read what they can, under what controls, and with what provenance.
* Review proposed integrations against your contracts and the program's participation requirements. Change your contracts when the evidence warrants and propose changes to the requirements.
* Design modernization paths for legacy sources that keep customers running through the transition, including moves from on\-premises to hybrid or cloud.
* Set query and index performance targets for catalog and access paths.
* Design the pipelines that keep the catalog, the search index, and the access views current as data arrives, from extractor output through backfill and recovery.
* Work directly with engineering: clarify designs, evaluate implementation plans, review delivered work against the decisions.
* Write the decision records and diagrams for your areas, and explain the tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.

 **What we work with:**

* .NET (C\#) services, Angular front ends, and a federated GraphQL gateway
* PostgreSQL by default, with Oracle and SQL Server across the installed base
* RabbitMQ for messaging and event\-driven change discovery
* Kubernetes and Helm alongside Windows installers for on\-premises and hybrid customers, with S3\-compatible object storage
* Scientific data in proprietary instrument formats as well as vendor\-neutral formats like Allotrope
* AI assistants in daily use

**Qualifications**
------------------

 **Required qualifications:**

* Has 8\+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture with distributed systems: service boundaries, APIs, and event\-driven integration.
* Has defined architecture ahead of finalized standards and governance and can show which decisions held up and which had to change.
* Has owned the architecture of a production system in at least one of these areas: data catalogs and metadata management (DataHub, OpenMetadata, or similar); search and indexing (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar); API or federated\-query data access layers (Apollo Federation, or similar); or the data layer of a scientific, laboratory, or regulated application.
* Writes SQL and reads execution plans in PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
* Has built and run data pipelines, including recovery and backfill.
* Reads production code in a typed language (C\#, Java, TypeScript, or similar) and can build a proof of concept.
* Uses AI tools in daily architecture and data work (profiling and cleaning data, reading and generating code, drafting decision records) and can show the process: what you delegate, what you verify, and how.
* Works across product, engineering, and business teams without direct authority.

 **Preferred qualifications:**

* Has delivered data products consumed by applications: APIs, views, or datasets that other software depends on.
* Working knowledge of catalog, search, and data access beyond the area you have owned.
* Laboratory informatics or regulated life sciences, including data integrity and audit trail expectations.
* Architecture decision records, C4 or similar diagrams, and interface contracts.
* Cloud integration patterns (identity, storage, messaging, managed data services) alongside on\-premises deployment.

 **Additional Details**


This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.
Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. During the hiring process, a recruiter can share more about the specific pay range for a preferred location. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

* **Support Enablement \& Knowledge Transfer**: Enabling Copilot support staff through internal documentation, guardrails, and targeted trainings; defining escalation patterns and support standards together with the support organization
* **Security Policies \& Controls**: Defining security controls and operational guardrails for Copilot usage
* **Plugin \& Integration Security**: Assessing custom Copilot plugins and third‑party integrations
* **Data Flow \& Encryption Validation**: Analyzing Copilot data flows and validating encryption and protection mechanisms

**Your Main Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of experience in Cybersecurity

* Full\-Stack Development – Proficiency in React and .NET Core for building responsive, scalable enterprise applications.
* Cloud Engineering – Hands\-on experience designing, deploying, and operating solutions on Microsoft Azure.
* Data Management – Experience with relational (SQL Azure) and NoSQL (Cosmos DB) databases in production environments.
* Integration Design – Ability to design and implement system integrations using REST APIs, messaging, and event\-driven patterns.
* DevOps Practices – Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Azure DevOps, and infrastructure\-as\-code (Bicep/ARM templates).
* Security Awareness – Understanding of cloud security principles, identity management (Azure AD/Entra ID), and secure coding practices.

  

**Qualifications** **Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

**Experience**

* Minimum 3–5 years of software development experience in a professional environment.
* Proven hands\-on experience with React and .NET Core API development.

* Experience working with SQL Azure (relational) and Azure Cosmos DB (NoSQL) in production systems.
* Experience with RESTful API design, system integration patterns, and enterprise application development.
* Microsoft Azure certification (e.g., AZ\-204 Developer Associate or AZ\-900\) preferred.

**Knowledge, Skills and Abilities**

new_jobs.title: Integration Software Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Heb jij ervaring met cloud\-native architecturen en integratieoplossingen? Ben jij degene die technische uitdagingen aangaat en deze vertaalt in praktische en schaalbare toepassingen? Wil jij jouw (AI) kennis inzetten om innovatieve oplossingen te realiseren? Dan zoeken wij jou als Integration Software Developer binnen ons Integratie Team bij Rensa Family Company.


Rensa Family Company is een groeiende organisatie binnen de technische groothandel waar efficiëntie en innovatie centraal staan. Als Software Developer werk je mee aan de doorontwikkeling van ons Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP). Dit platform speelt een belangrijke rol in het verbinden van onze IT\-systemen en het ondersteunen van onze bedrijfsprocessen.


Jouw expertise en visie zorgen ervoor dat we ons integratielandschap moderniseren en toekomstbestendig maken. Samen met het team ontwikkel je oplossingen voor complexe IT\-vraagstukken en help je onze organisatie verder te digitaliseren.

**Wat doet het Hybrid Integration Platform (HIP)?**


Het Hybrid Integration Platform is ontworpen om applicaties op een gestandaardiseerde, schaalbare en onderhoudbare manier te integreren. Het biedt een cloud\-native foundation die zowel cloud\-based als on\-premise systemen bindt in een event\-driven architectuur.


Met technologieën zoals Azure Service Bus, Docker, ASP.NET Core Web API en Azure Functions, helpt HIP ons om integratiecomplexiteit te verminderen, ontwikkelingscycli te versnellen en flexibele samenwerking tussen onze systemen mogelijk te maken.

**Jouw rol als Engineer**


Als Integration Software Engineer draag je verantwoordelijkheid voor:

* Ontwerp en ontwikkeling: Het ontwerpen, realiseren en optimaliseren van HIP\-componenten zoals adapters, services en event\-driven messaging.
* Samenwerking binnen het team: Je werkt nauw samen met collega\-developers, architecten en andere stakeholders om kwalitatieve integratieoplossingen te realiseren.
* Standaardisatie en kwaliteit: Je ontwikkelt oplossingen volgens de geldende integratiestandaarden, waaronder het gebruik van het Rensa Data Model (RDM) en Canonical Data Models.
* Samenwerking met business en IT\-stakeholders: Je vertaalt zakelijke behoeften naar technische oplossingen en werkt samen aan het verbeteren van processen en technologieën
* Continue verbetering: Je blijft op de hoogte van ontwikkelingen binnen integratie\- en cloudtechnologieën en draagt actief bij aan het verbeteren van bestaande oplossingen en ontwikkelprocessen.
* Toepassen van AI: Je zet AI\-tools in om ontwikkeling, testen, documentatie en analyse van integratieoplossingen efficiënter en kwalitatief beter uit te voeren.
* Testen en beheer: Je bent betrokken bij het testen, documenteren, monitoren en onderhouden van integratieoplossingen om een stabiele en betrouwbare dienstverlening te waarborgen.

**Technologieën waarmee je gaat werken**

* .NET (C\#)
* Azure Service Bus
* Azure API Management
* Azure Functions
* ASP.NET Web API
* Azure CosmosDB
* Azure Storage\-accounts
* Azure SQL
* Azure Container Apps
* Docker (en Kubernetes via Azure Container Apps Environment)
* KEDA voor event\-driven autoscaling
* Azure DevOps
* AI tooling: GitHub, Copilot, chatGPT, Codex etc.

**Wat maakt jou een goede kandidaat om ons team te versterken?**

* (Ruime) ervaring met softwareontwikkeling, bij voorkeur in .NET (C\#);
* Ervaring met het Azure platform en Azure Services zoals Service Bus, API Management, CosmosDB, Storage Accounts en Functions;
* Het begrijpen en toepassen van containertechnologieën (bijv. Docker) en cloud\-native principes;
* Kennis van event\-driven architecturen en publish/subscribe messaging;
* Ervaring met het implementeren en beheren van RESTful APIs en API\-gateways.
* In staat om effectief samen te werken binnen een multidisciplinair ontwikkelteam en kennis te delen met collega’s.
* Leergierig en continu gericht op het verbeteren van kennis en codekwaliteit.

**Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?**


Wij bieden wij een heel mooi pakket aan arbeidsvoorwaarden:

* Salaris tussen de €4\.000,\- en €5\.500,\- bruto per maand, afhankelijk van jouw kennis en ervaring.
* 40 vrije dagen op fulltime basis, waarvan 28 vakantiedagen en 12 verlofdagen;
* Een innovatieve werkomgeving waar jouw ideeën en technische expertise gewaardeerd worden.
* Een organisatie met een visie en focus op duurzaamheid en lange termijn impact;
* Vooroplopen in je vak. Je werkt met de nieuwste technologie, samenwerken met sterke partners en ervaren collega’s;
* Goede verhouding tussen thuiswerken en op kantoor;
* Deelname aan een target\- en winstregeling;
* Een premievrije pensioenregeling met mogelijkheid zelf extra bij te sparen;
* Fijne werksfeer met betrokken collega’s, leuke teamactiviteiten en een actieve personeelsvereniging – work hard, have fun! “We have fun working together” staat niet voor niets in onze strategie.
* Sterke laptop en telefoon van de zaak.
* Tegemoetkoming reiskosten woon\-werkverkeer van € 0\.25 per kilometer.

**Rensa Family. Groots worden doe je samen.**


Werken onder de paraplu van Rensa Family betekent samen met je collega’s bouwen aan stabiele groei. We willen samen met jou de beste partner van de installateur zijn op het gebied van expertise, technisch advies en logistiek. Je krijgt alle ruimte voor persoonlijke groei, ontwikkeling en welzijn. Zodat je trots kunt zijn op je werk, jezelf en je team: samen naar steeds betere, duurzame resultaten! Voor jou als talent of professional en voor Rensa Family als bedrijf. Word wat je wilt, blijf gewoon jezelf. Rensa Family. Groots worden doe je samen.


Klaar om impact te maken?

new_jobs.title: Afdelingsmanager engineering & aanleg
new_jobs.description:
* Den Bosch
* € 5\.704,\- en € 8\.149,\-
* WO
* 40 uur


  
* ### **Wat ga je doen?**

#### **Met jouw energie kan het**


	+ Jij leidt als manager de afdeling Engineering en Aanleg en daarmee lever je een cruciale bijdrage aan de energietransitie in Brabant.
	+ Je bent een ervaren "senior" manager, die eigenaarschap combineert met samenwerken. Je bent de motor achter de productie, resultaatgericht en vernieuwend.
	+ Je kunt daarbij rekenen op goede arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals een persoonlijk budget en de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen.
Ben jij een ervaren manager die uitblinkt in het uitzetten en bewaken van een duidelijke koers, sterk is in het creëren van verbinding én gevoel heeft voor samenwerking en ontwikkeling? Ben jij toe aan jouw volgende stap richting senior management niveau? Enexis zoekt een afdelingsmanager Engineering \& Aanleg voor de vestiging Brabant Noordoost in Den Bosch!

#### **Zo ga jij deze uitdaging aan**


De energietransitie zorgt ervoor dat de netbeheerders de komende decennia een enorm werkpakket hebben. Ons motto voor de komende jaren is simpel: bouwen, bouwen, bouwen. We moeten hiervoor al onze beschikbare mensen inzetten, zowel intern als bij onze samenwerkingspartners. Tegelijkertijd is de uitdaging voldoende mensen op te leiden en te ontwikkelen tot vakbekwame collega’s én is veilig werken essentieel. Dit vraagt om duidelijke visie en scherpe keuzes, feeling met de werkvloer en creativiteit. Spreekt je dit aan, reageer dan!


Jouw belangrijkste speerpunten in de functie manager Engineering \& Aanleg


De vestiging Brabant Noordoost in Den Bosch is één van de tien regionale vestigingen binnen het werkgebied van Enexis. De vestiging bestaat uit ongeveer 300 collega’s en samen met de vestigingsmanager, de manager Realisatie en de manager Work Force Management vorm je het MT van de vestiging. Jij bent verantwoordelijk voor de afdeling Engineering en Aanleg. In deze uitdagende rol geef jij direct sturing aan een team van 3 teammanagers en indirect aan ongeveer 60 collega’s die actief zijn binnen de afdeling Engineering en Aanleg. Daarnaast geef je indirect sturing aan minstens zoveel collega’s van de contractpartners.


Je bent eindverantwoordelijk voor het gehele werkpakket voor de ontwikkeling en aanleg van energienetten (gas en elektra) binnen het verzorgingsgebied Brabant Noordoost (jaarlijkse omvang meer dan 80 miljoen euro). We zitten midden in de energietransitie. Het werkpakket groeit en geen dag is hetzelfde. Als afdelingsmanager heb je daardoor veel ballen in de lucht te houden. Met jouw eerdere ervaringen als manager en jouw verandervermogen geef je leiding en richting aan de resultaten en ontwikkeling van de afdeling.


Je zorgt samen met je teammanagers en medewerkers dat de doelstellingen worden behaald. Je stimuleert continue verbetering waarbij werkplezier het uitgangspunt is. Daarnaast zoek je actief de samenwerking op met verschillende afdelingen binnen Enexis en met onze partners extern. Goed stakeholder management is dan ook echt belangrijk voor zowel intern als extern in de markt. Je stuurt op prestaties en bewaakt de kwaliteit van het te leveren werk van jouw afdeling, de afdeling Engineering en Aanleg. Jij rapporteert hierover aan de vestigingsmanager. Door jouw rol in het lokale MT neem jij samen met collega MT leden besluiten over de richting en uitvoering van de strategische thema’s. Deze draag je op doel\- en actiegerichte wijze uit binnen de organisatie met oog voor de mens én het collectief.
* ### **Functie\-eisen**

#### **Zo pak jij het aan**


We zoeken een ervaren, inspirerende en doelgerichte manager die knopen durft door te hakken, energie heeft en ook rust en structuur brengt. Iemand die toe is aan zijn volgende management rol. Je beschikt over minimaal een HBO/academisch werk\- en denkniveau en hebt meer dan 5 jaar leidinggevende ervaring op vergelijkbaar niveau.


Deze rol vraagt niet alleen *om teamontwikkeling*, maar ook om inhoudelijke betrokkenheid. Je hebt een grote affiniteit met operationele processen en ervaring in een technische werkomgeving. Je benadert zaken vanuit verschillende perspectieven en bent positief met een oplossingsgerichte mindset. Verder heb jij ervaring met stakeholders in de organisatie maar ook vooral erbuiten en weet jij als geen ander om betrokken partijen bij elkaar te brengen.
* ### **Team \& cultuur**

#### **Je zet je schouders eronder met...**


Op de vestiging in Den Bosch heerst een informele en professionele sfeer. We stellen de ontwikkeling en veiligheid van onze medewerkers voorop. Door de uitdagingen van de energietransitie nemen we doorlopende nieuwe collega’s aan. We leiden onze collega’s en samenwerkingspartners veelal zelf op wat zorgt voor mooie kansen maar ook voor de nodige uitdagingen op gebied van begeleiding en het verzetten van ons werkpakket. Onze uitdagende strategie kunnen we alleen realiseren met versnelling op het juiste gedrag en leiderschap. We versterken elkaar met onze drie kernwaarden Duidelijk, Inclusief en Lerend.


We vinden het belangrijk dat je je bij ons thuis voelt. We zijn allemaal anders en het mooie daarvan is dat we elkaar vanuit die verschillen aanvullen. We hebben elkaars perspectieven en meningen nodig voor een succesvolle energietransitie! Lees hier mee over ons beleid op diversiteit en inclusie.
* ### **Wat krijg je van ons?**

#### **En wij steken natuurlijk ook energie in jou**


Bij Enexis werk je in de voorhoede van een van de grootste uitdagingen van onze tijd: de energietransitie. Daarbij zorgen we goed voor je. Dat begint met een uitgebreid welkomstpakket en \-programma om je collega’s te leren kennen. En met goede arbeidsvoorwaarden:


	+ Salaris tussen € 5\.704, \- en € 8\.149, \- bruto per maand (op basis van 40 uur per week, schaal 17\). Inclusief secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden kan je salaris oplopen tot € 10\.488, \- bruto per maand.
	+ Bijdrage van 70% aan je ABP Keuzepensioen.
	+ Persoonlijk budget van 10% en een 13e maand van 10,7% van je bruto jaarsalaris. Deze kun je flexibel inzetten of maandelijks of jaarlijks laten uitbetalen.
	+ 24,5 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband. Meer oplaadtijd nodig? Met je persoonlijk budget en 13e maand koop je tot wel 35,5 extra verlofdagen.
	+ Mogelijkheden om thuis te werken, inclusief een door ons ingerichte thuiswerkplek en een vergoeding van € 2,45 per thuiswerkdag.
	+ Een mobiliteitskaart waarmee je eerste klas reist en een reiskostenvergoeding.
	+ Laptop of tablet en telefoon die je ook privé mag gebruiken.
	+ Vitaliteitsbudget van € 700,\- voor bijvoorbeeld een sportabonnement.
	+ Ruimte om te groeien met ons interne ontwikkelplatform of externe opleidingen en trainingen.  

Lees meer over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden.


Werk als Manager E\&A aan het energienetwerk van morgen


Solliciteer uiterlijk woensdag 30 september via de button onder aan deze pagina. Solliciteer via deze website, dus niet per e\-mail. We werven tegelijkertijd intern en extern en gaan voor de beste kandidaat. We ontvangen graag je cv en motivatiebrief. Heb je vragen over de functie? Neem dan contact op met *Didianne van Wijngaarden*, corporate recruiter.


Goed om te weten


	+ Het 1e selectiegesprek worden gevoerd vanaf de 1e week van oktober. Een selectieassessment is onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure.
	+ Een screening is onderdeel van de sollicitatieprocedure. Naast het assessment maakt het opvragen van referenties en een Verklaring Omtrent het Gedrag (VOG) onderdeel uit van de procedure. Hierover ontvang je meer informatie tijdens de procedure.
**Hoe kan ik je verder helpen?**
--------------------------------

### **Didianne van Wijngaarden**


Heb je een vraag of wil je eens kennismaken? Je kan ons altijd e\-mailen.

  




### **Wat wij jou bieden**


Kom werken in een bedrijf dat net zoveel energie in jou steekt als jij in je werk.### **Persoonlijk budget**


Persoonlijk budget van 10% en een 13e maand van 10,7% van je brutojaarsalaris. Deze kun je flexibel inzetten of maandelijks of jaarlijks laten uitbetalen.### **Vakantiedagen**


24,5 vakantiedagen bij een fulltime dienstverband. Meer oplaadtijd nodig? Met je persoonlijk budget en 13e maand koop je tot wel 35,5 extra verlofdagen.### **Pensioenregeling**


Bij Enexis draag je niet alleen bij aan een betere wereld, maar bouw je ook aan je eigen toekomst. We dragen namelijk 70% bij aan je ABP Keuzepensioen.### **Thuiswerken en apparatuur**


Je kunt thuiswerken met een door Enexis ingerichte werkplek. Laptop en telefoon die je ontvangt, mag je ook privé gebruiken.### **Reiskostenvergoeding**


Reiskostenvergoeding en een 1e klas ov\-abonnement voor zakelijk gebruik. Ook hebben we een fietsplan om je te stimuleren vaker voor de fiets te kiezen.### **Ondersteuning**


Een vitaliteitsbudget van €700 voor bijv. sportabonnementen. Gezinsuitbreiding? Tijdens het 1e levensjaar van je kind krijg je 9 weken 70% van je dagloon vergoed.
Laat meer zien



**Sollicitatieproces**
----------------------

* 1### **Sollicitatie ontvangen**


Je ontvangt binnen 5 werkdagen een reactie van ons, tenzij in de vacaturetekst expliciet een andere reactietermijn is vermeld.
* 2### **Kennismakingsgesprek**


Tijd om elkaar te leren kennen. Wie ben je? Wat doe je graag? Waarom deze functie? En niet onbelangrijk: Wat wil jij weten van ons?
* 3### **Vervolggesprek**


We horen graag over je werkervaringen en waarom de functie op je lijf geschreven staat. Daarnaast zullen we ook dieper ingaan op de inhoud van de functie. Heb je nog vragen over Enexis of de functie waarop je solliciteert? Deze beantwoorden we natuurlijk graag.
* 4### **Arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek**


Is er een wederzijdse match? Dan doen we je graag een aanbod bestaande uit een passend salaris en onze arbeidsvoorwaarden, zoals het aantal vakantiedagen en een persoonlijk budget: Enexis zorgt voor jou – ook buiten je werktijden.
* 5### **Een warm welkom!**


Het sollicitatieproces zit erop. Je hoeft alleen nog maar je handtekening te zetten en dan start jouw avontuur bij Enexis. Tot snel, collega!

new_jobs.title: Senior Cloud Enterprise Architect (Azure/Data Fabric/AI agents)
new_jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

##### **Responsibilities**


Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment


Act as a trusted advisor for the customer to ensure alignment with strategic goals, advocate customer's interests when working in a diverse team of various stakeholders, and promote cutting\-edge cloud technologies.


Design and adopt governance automation services by leveraging new technology paradigms (e.g. serverless, containers, microservices) and cloud best practices


Work as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams


Producing technical documentation and architecture decision records.


Implement DevOps practices such as infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployment


Coordination of team resources to solve problems and technical issues


Work in Agile (Scrum, Kanban), defining, estimating, and delivering stories


##### **Skills**


Must have


Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),


Python,


Microsoft Azure DevOps,


Microsoft Azure Services,


Microsoft Data Fabric, FabricIO, O365 agents


experience with building AI Agents,


medallion architecture,


Network,


CI/CD


Nice to have


Proven experience of working with MS Data Fabric,


MS Data Fabric DP\-600/700 certifications,


Azure Architect certifications,


AI Landing zones,


Python/C\# proficiency, Databricks,


self\-driven/self\-motivated.

**Machine Learning Engineer, Associate Director – AI Innovation Teams**


Fitch Ratings is seeking a Machine Learning Engineer to join our new AI Innovation teams in Manchester—a bold initiative building the AI\-powered future of financial analysis. We're not fine\-tuning existing models or optimizing yesterday's algorithms. We're architecting the next generation: sophisticated agentic AI systems, intelligent automation that thinks, and ML capabilities that will redefine how credit analysis happens and how global financial markets consume insights.


This is AI's moment at Fitch, and we're moving decisively. We have executive sponsorship, significant investment, and we're establishing Toronto as our AI innovation center. As a Lead ML Engineer, you'll be a technical champion driving this transformation—building breakthrough ML systems that others will study, mentoring engineers who will become tomorrow's AI leaders, and establishing patterns that will scale across the organization. You're joining at the perfect inflection point: early enough to architect foundational decisions, resourced enough to execute boldly.


We need ML technologists who see greenfield opportunities as fuel rather than fear—whether you're an ML architect ready to design intelligent systems from first principles, an AI engineering leader who translates research breakthroughs into production reality, or a seasoned practitioner who recognizes that this moment demands courage over caution. If you're motivated by "let's prove this is possible" rather than "we need more data before we decide," this is a high\-impact role where you'll spend less time justifying AI's potential and more time realizing it—alongside exceptional engineers who share your conviction that we're building something significant.


This role is ideal for someone who wants to remain deeply hands\-on while operating at a senior level. You will contribute technical expertise, influence decision\-making through strong engineering judgment, and partner closely with engineering leaders, product teams, and fellow engineers to deliver innovative AI solutions at scale. *This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct people management responsibilities*


**What We Offer:**


* **Ground\-floor ML leadership with enterprise resources** – Define the ML architecture, technical standards, and engineering practices for Fitch's AI future while having the compute, research budgets, and organizational backing that most AI startups would envy; mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while remaining deeply hands\-on with the most challenging technical problems
* **Build breakthrough ML systems that matter** – Develop net\-new generative AI platforms, multi\-agent orchestration systems, and intelligent automation that will process billions in credit decisions; experiment with frontier models, novel architectures, and unconventional approaches; see your ML innovations directly impact how global financial markets operate
* **Access to cutting\-edge ML infrastructure and research** – Work with the latest LLMs, fine\-tune foundation models, leverage enterprise\-scale GPU clusters, experiment with emerging frameworks before they're mainstream, and collaborate with academic ML researchers; substantial conference and training budgets to stay at the forefront of AI innovation
* **Shape ML governance and standards for an organization** – Establish the ML engineering practices, model governance frameworks, and AI integration patterns that will guide Fitch's AI transformation; your architectural decisions will influence how a global financial services leader approaches intelligent systems
* **Real production impact with sophisticated ML challenges** – Build ML systems that analysts and financial professionals actually use daily; solve hard problems at the intersection of NLP, document intelligence, reasoning systems, and production\-scale deployment; measure your impact in both model performance and business outcomes
* **Accelerated career trajectory in AI leadership** – High visibility to C\-suite executives making billion\-dollar strategic decisions; clear advancement paths to Principal ML Architect or AI Research Lead roles; opportunity to establish yourself as a recognized voice in financial AI and earn a reputation that opens doors across the industry

**We'll Count on You To:**


* **Build transformative ML systems from the ground up** – Design and architect net\-new generative AI solutions, agentic workflows, and intelligent platforms using advanced ML frameworks (PyTorch, etc.), large language models, and emerging AI technologies that fundamentally change how analysts work and how Fitch operates
* **Drive breakthrough AI innovation and experimentation boldly** – Lead exploration of generative AI, multi\-agent systems, RAG architectures, model fine\-tuning, prompt engineering, and other emerging ML technologies; create cutting\-edge proofs\-of\-concept; evaluate what's transformative versus what's hype; and turn research into production\-quality AI capabilities
* **Define ML technical vision and architecture for the future** – Shape architectural decisions for ML systems, establish ML engineering standards, drive technology and framework choices, and influence how Fitch approaches intelligent platforms and AI governance across the organization
* **Lead through innovation, influence, and mentorship** – Mentor and coach fellow ML engineers while partnering with product squads, business stakeholders, and cross\-functional teams to translate ambitious AI ideas into elegant technical solutions; foster a culture of experimentation, continuous learning, and calculated risk\-taking
* **Champion ML excellence while moving fast** – Balance innovation velocity with ML engineering best practices; implement robust CI/CD pipelines for ML systems; develop scalable APIs (FastAPI, etc.) for model deployment; solve novel technical challenges at the intersection of cutting\-edge AI research and production systems; and build solutions that are both breakthrough and reliable
* **Drive ML governance and operational excellence** – Ensure adherence to AI/ML governance guidelines, monitor SLAs for AI solutions, optimize model performance and reliability, and translate complex ML concepts for both technical and non\-technical audiences across distributed teams
* **Shape team culture and technical direction** – Help define how our AI innovation teams operate, what "good" looks like for ML engineering, and how we balance exploration with delivery; model the curiosity, boldness, and technical rigor needed to succeed in a greenfield ML innovation environment

**What You Need to Have:**


* **Deep ML technical expertise** – 12\+ years of professional experience building production AI/ML systems, with strong proficiency in Python, ML algorithms (from classical techniques to deep learning), and modern ML frameworks; proven track record of delivering advanced generative AI and ML solutions
* **ML architectural mastery and greenfield experience** – Demonstrated experience designing scalable ML systems from scratch; deep understanding of ML system architecture, model deployment patterns, and the ability to make bold architectural decisions for AI platforms in ambiguous environments
* **Advanced generative AI expertise** – Extensive hands\-on experience developing and integrating generative AI solutions, working with large language models, building agentic systems, implementing RAG architectures, and training/fine\-tuning neural networks using frameworks like PyTorch
* **Bachelor's degree in Machine Learning, Computer Science, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, or related field**
* **Production ML engineering excellence** – Deep understanding of ML operations, including containerization (Docker, Kubernetes/AWS EKS), cloud platforms (AWS/Azure), workflow orchestration (Airflow), automated testing for ML systems, and API development for model deployment
* **Technical leadership and influence** – Track record of mentoring and coaching engineers, driving ML initiatives in fast\-moving environments, leading through technical excellence and influence rather than authority, and building credibility through results and vision
* **Innovation and experimentation mindset** – Demonstrated history of exploring emerging ML technologies, building AI proofs\-of\-concept, learning from failures, and translating cutting\-edge research into production systems; comfort with ambiguity and rapid technological change
* **Outstanding collaboration and communication** – Ability to articulate ML technical vision to diverse audiences, work effectively with product squads and business partners, translate complex AI/ML concepts for non\-technical stakeholders, and bring your whole self while remaining open to others' perspectives

**What Would Make You Stand Out:**


* **Cutting\-edge AI research to production experience** – Track record of taking breakthrough AI capabilities from research/prototype to production\-scale deployment; experience supporting seamless transitions from experimentation to enterprise\-grade ML systems with real users
* **ML thought leadership and technical strategy** – History of establishing technical direction for ML initiatives, contributing to open\-source ML projects, speaking at AI/ML conferences, publishing research, or writing about practical applications of emerging AI technologies
* **Multi\-agent and agentic systems expertise** – Hands\-on experience building multi\-agent systems, agentic workflows, tool\-using AI systems, or complex AI orchestration platforms that go beyond simple LLM integrations
* **Advanced cloud\-native ML infrastructure** – Deep expertise building sophisticated ML infrastructure, MLOps pipelines, model serving platforms, and cloud\-native AI systems at scale; experience optimizing cost and performance of production LLM deployments
* **Financial services or analytical domain knowledge** – Understanding of analytical workflows, credit analysis processes, regulatory requirements, financial data products, or how ML enables better financial decision\-making; familiarity with credit ratings agencies is a significant advantage
* **Startup or innovation team experience** – History of building greenfield ML products, working in fast\-paced AI innovation environments, or being part of 0\-to\-1 ML initiatives within larger organizations where you shaped technical direction.

  

If you're ready to build transformative ML systems with organizational backing, talented colleagues, and the resources to succeed—this is the moment to join us.


**Why Fitch?**
--------------


At Fitch Group, the combined power of our global perspectives is what differentiates us. Our global network of colleagues comes together to accomplish things greater than they ever could alone.


Every team member is essential to our business, and each perspective is critical to our success. We embrace a diverse culture that encourages a free exchange of ideas, guaranteeing your voice will be heard and your work will have an impact, regardless of seniority.


We are building incredible things at Fitch and we invite you to join us on our journey.


**About Fitch Group**
---------------------


Fitch Group is a global leader in financial information services with operations in more than 30 countries. Wholly owned by the Hearst Corporation, we are comprised of three main businesses: Fitch Ratings \| Fitch Solutions \| Fitch Learning.


For more information please visit our websites: www.fitchratings.com \| www.fitchsolutions.com \| www.fitchlearning.com


Fitch is committed to providing global securities markets with objective, timely, independent and forward\-looking credit opinions. To protect Fitch's credibility and reputation, our employees must take every precaution to avoid conflicts of interests or any appearance of a conflict of interest. Should you be successful in the recruitment process at Fitch Ratings you will be asked to declare any securities holdings and other potential conflicts prior to commencing employment. If you, or your immediate family, have any holdings that may conflict with your work responsibilities, you may be asked to divest yourself of them before beginning work.

A little more about your role…
Join a team passionate about decarbonising energy use in buildings – a vital component of the drive to Net Zero. WSP’s Energy Solutions team provide market\-leading competency in the development of heat networks, and private wire electrical networks. Working with public and private sector clients, we’re helping local communities, universities and health trusts to identify, design and deliver decarbonisation solutions for their buildings.  



  

We’re looking to grow our team of Electrical Engineers in response to increasing demand for decarbonisation services.
  

You’ll be responsible for the design and development of private wire networks, and low carbon energy centres.
  

You’ll be supporting the Mechanical team with the design of electrical services for low\-carbon energy centre and district energy schemes.  



  

Your duties will also include:  



  

Leading electrical designs (11kV and LV) from feasibility through to construction.
  

Undertaking site surveys and quality audits.
  

Meeting with clients and contractors on a project basis under suitable guidance.
  

Producing engineering drawings, calculations, schedules, specifications and reports in accordance with WSP’s project commitments.
  

Surveying existing facilities \& developing resilient infrastructure upgrade strategies.
  

Preparing feasibility studies and technical reports.
  

Producing CDM risk assessments.
  

Undertake review of contractor’s design submissions.
  

Supporting \& mentoring junior engineers where appropriate.
  

Coordinating with clients, contractors \& multidisciplinary design teams.
  

Develop and maintain strong client relationships.
  

You’ll ensure that relevant Health and Safety risks and hazards are identified, made known to the project team and properly managed.
  

We always look to empower our people in their project roles and you’ll be encouraged to take on the management of projects and have direct engagement with your clients, and you’ll be supported with appropriate training and guidance from your project director.  



  

What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…  



  

You’ll have a relevant degree in Electrical Engineering (or equivalent qualification and/or experience) and be looking to broaden your skillset to include design of HV and LV electrical systems.
  

CEng or IEng status is desirable but not essential.
  

You will be comfortable working collaboratively with WSP team members and external parties such as manufacturers, contractors, and clients.  



  

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**  

  

Join our close\-knit community of talented individuals who share your passion for making a positive impact. Our global team includes more than 69,000 employees, working together to make a difference in communities both close to home and around the world.
  

  

**With us, you can. Apply today.**

new_jobs.title: Multi Skilled Services Engineer (Mechanical)
new_jobs.description:
Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust is looking for a skilled and motivated Multi Skilled Services Engineer (Plumber) to join our Estates and Facilities team. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in maintaining the engineering infrastructure that supports the delivery of outstanding patient care across our hospital sites.
  
  

The successful candidate will provide a comprehensive plumbing and mechanical maintenance service, carrying out planned preventative maintenance, reactive repairs, fault finding, testing, inspections, and installation work across a diverse healthcare estate. Working on a range of systems including domestic water services, pumps, pipework, sanitary systems, and mechanical plant, you will help ensure that essential services remain safe, reliable, and fully operational.
  
  

In return, we offer a supportive working environment, ongoing training and development opportunities, access to the NHS Pension Scheme, generous annual leave entitlement, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career within one of London's leading NHS Trusts.
  
  

If you are a dedicated plumbing professional looking for a varied and rewarding role where your work directly contributes to patient safety and operational excellence, we would be delighted to hear from you. Join us and help maintain the environments that enable exceptional care for our patients, visitors, and staff every day.
  
  

The postholder is responsible for delivering safe, effective, and compliant mechanical maintenance services across the Trust, ensuring all work is undertaken in accordance with statutory regulations, HTMs, British Standards, and Trust policies. The role includes managing planned and reactive maintenance through the CAFM system, maintaining accurate records, supporting audits and compliance activities, and contributing to the safe operation of critical engineering systems. The postholder will monitor performance, support continuous service improvements, participate in training and professional development, and promote high standards of health, safety, governance, and risk management. They will also support budgetary control through efficient use of resources, liaise with contractors and stakeholders, participate in the on\-call rota, and work flexibly across Trust sites as a multi\-skilled technician to ensure the delivery of reliable, patient\-focused Estates services.
  
  

Our Trust is one of England's top\-performing and safest trusts. We operate two main acute hospital sites—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—along with award\-winning clinics across North West London.
  
  

Our nearly 7,500 staff care for a diverse population of 1\.5m, providing full clinical services including maternity, A\&E and children’s services, plus specialist HIV and sexual health care. The CQC rates us Good in safety, effectiveness, care and responsiveness, and Outstanding in leadership and resource use.
  
  

We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Mid.
  
  

We are delivering sustainable healthcare through our Green Plan. In line with Greener NHS ambitions, we aim for net zero carbon emissions by 2045\. Achieving this requires collective effort. We encourage staff to reduce their impact on carbon, waste and pollution wherever possible. Every action counts to create a healthier, more sustainable future.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and believe diversity drives innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities, valuing the perspectives they bring.
  
  

The postholder is responsible for providing a comprehensive, high\-quality mechanical engineering maintenance service across the Trust’s estate, ensuring that all plant, equipment and engineering systems are maintained in a safe, reliable and compliant condition to support the delivery of patient care. The role encompasses the planned and reactive maintenance of a wide range of mechanical systems, including heating, ventilation, water services, pressure systems, medical gases and other specialist infrastructure, ensuring compliance with all relevant statutory legislation, Health Technical Memoranda (HTMs), British Standards, Trust policies and industry best practice. The postholder will use the Trust’s CAFM system to manage, prioritise and record maintenance activities, ensuring accurate documentation of all works undertaken, compliance records, asset information and audit evidence. They will contribute to the achievement of regulatory compliance through participation in Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) programmes, inspections, audits, risk assessments and permit\-to\-work systems, while actively identifying, escalating and mitigating risks that may affect operational service delivery.
  
  

The role requires a strong commitment to quality, safety and continuous improvement, including monitoring equipment performance, analysing maintenance trends, supporting service improvement initiatives and contributing technical expertise to engineering projects and operational decision\-making. The postholder will maintain up\-to\-date professional knowledge through ongoing training and development, supporting the Trust’s compliance agenda and progression towards Competent Person, Responsible Person or Authorising Person status where appropriate. They will promote effective governance by adhering to all Health \& Safety requirements, safe systems of work and risk management procedures, while ensuring contractors and colleagues work in accordance with statutory obligations and Trust standards. In addition, the postholder will support efficient financial management through the effective use of resources, stock control, procurement support and the delivery of cost\-effective maintenance solutions.
  
  

Working as part of a multidisciplinary Estates team, the postholder will provide a flexible and responsive service across all Trust sites, participating in the on\-call rota and responding to emergency situations as required. They will liaise professionally with clinical teams, patients, visitors, contractors and colleagues, maintaining excellent communication and customer service standards at all times. The role requires the ability to operate as a multi\-skilled technician, undertaking a variety of engineering and non\-engineering maintenance tasks to support the wider Estates function, ensuring that the Trust’s buildings, infrastructure and critical services remain safe, compliant, operationally effective and fit for purpose.

new_jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Azure/MS Data Fabric/Collibra)
new_jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

##### **Responsibilities**


Support the integration between Collibra and Microsoft Fabric, including evaluating Fabric's capabilities for data provision.


Manage Fabric\-native catalog and discovery functionalities.


Oversee metadata management and business glossary maintenance.


Facilitate data product discovery and data shopping processes.


Handle governance, access management, and data protection policies.


Lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives and validate Fabric architecture.


Design components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers.


Develop cloud architectural strategies ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.


Serve as a trusted advisor to align technical solutions with strategic objectives and advocate customer interests among diverse stakeholders.


Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.


Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.


Produce technical documentation, architecture decision records, and implement DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployments.


Coordinate team resources, resolve technical issues, and work within Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, for defining, estimating, and delivering work.

experience in building AI Landing zones,


experience with FabricIO \& o365 agents,

self\-driven/self\-motivated,

##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

Shape customer's architectural strategy to create a secure, scalable, and compliant cloud environment

new_jobs.title: Manager Software Engineering
new_jobs.description:
**Do you enjoy working close to cutting‑edge technology?**


If the answer is yes, imagine stepping into a role where your leadership directly shapes the future of embedded systems, cloud software and user experience. Picture a position where you get to guide passionate engineers — and together explore what’s possible within marine technology.  

This is what Humphree can offer you in this exciting opportunity.


We are now looking for a **Manager for the Software Engineering Team** at Humphree.


The team consists of developers working with embedded software, user interface design, backend and frontend development for our cloud platform, as well as software testers. Together they build the complete software ecosystem that powers Humphree’s world‑leading stabilization solutions.


As Manager for the Software Team, you will lead and develop this diverse group, ensuring that the team thrives, collaborates and continues to deliver high‑quality software that moves the company forward. You will work closely with Humphree’s CTO and be part of the R\&D management team.

**Key Deliverables**

* Lead, support and mentor a multidisciplinary team of software developers and testers
* Build and nurture a high‑performing team culture where people feel motivated, safe and inspired
* Drive continuous improvements in ways of working, processes and collaboration
* Ensure technical direction and alignment across embedded development, cloud services and user interface components
* Secure high software quality throughout the full development chain
* Work closely with product owners and other leaders within R\&D to deliver on our technology roadmap

**How can you contribute?**


You understand that great software is built by great teams — and that leadership is about enabling people to grow, collaborate and succeed. You reflect on challenges from different angles and turn insights into decisions that help both the team and the product move forward.


You have confidence in your own technical background while staying curious and open to new perspectives. You enjoy connecting with people, building relationships and contributing to a positive team atmosphere. Collaboration comes naturally to you, and you are comfortable asking for input as well as offering support.


As Humphree is a fast‑moving and innovative company, we believe you enjoy working close to both strategy and hands‑on development questions. You are comfortable switching between a high‑level view and detailed technical discussions when needed.


You are a natural and authentic leader with a coaching mindset. You listen well, communicate clearly and help ideas gain traction.

**We believe you have:**

* A university degree (MSc or similar) within software engineering, computer science, electrical engineering or a related field
* A background in software development, preferably with experience in C, C\+\+ and C\#
* Experience in leading people — as a manager, team lead or similar
* Experience from or familiarity with agile software development methods
* Strong communication skills and the ability to create trust and engagement around you

**Full\-stack Developer – Develop NODES Trading Platform**
==========================================================


NODES is hiring a Full\-stack Developer.
  

  

We are looking for a technically strong, hands\-on and collaborative engineer who has the skillset to contribute to the overall solution we are developing. You have solid experience in system design, software development and modern delivery practices.


We do not expect the candidate to tick every box. If you have strong experience with cloud platforms and software development, and you are motivated to learn the energy\-market domain, we would like to hear from you.


**Where will you make an impact?**


You will work across the full NODES Trading Platform, from customer\-facing applications and backend services to cloud infrastructure, integrations, security and production operations.


Working in a cross\-functional DevSecOps product team, you will help improve the platform we operate today and shape the technical foundation we build on next.

You will influence solutions from early design through production, contribute to architectural and technical decisions, and help us continuously improve scalability, availability, performance and security.

* C\# and .NET
* Microsoft Azure
* Angular and Vue
* REST APIs and microservices
* Azure Service Bus and event\-driven architecture

You will not be limited to implementation tasks.


We expect you to contribute ideas, challenge existing solutions constructively and help improve how we design, build, test and operate the platform.

* Working in an agile, cross\-functional development environment.
* Automated testing, secure development and maintainable software design.
* Event\-driven or distributed systems.
* Infrastructure as Code, DevSecOps or CI/CD.
* Monitoring and operating cloud services in production.
* Knowledge of the energy sector or energy\-market systems.
* Strong written and spoken English.

**Personal skills**


You will join a small, skilled and collaborative technology team where we are expected to contribute ideas, challenge assumptions, learn from each other and improve how we build and operate software. Your key personal skills should be:


* Independent and comfortable taking ownership, while being a strong collaborator.
* Structured, pragmatic and solution\-oriented.
* Curious and motivated to keep learning new technologies.
* Clear in your communication and constructive in technical discussions.

**Why join NODES?**


* Purpose with impact: Build technology that supports the energy transition and more efficient use of electricity grids.
* Full\-stack ownership: Influence solutions across user experience, backend services, integrations, cloud infrastructure and production.
* Technical influence: Contribute to architecture, engineering practices and technology choices.
* Varied challenges: Solve problems involving scalability, security, distributed systems, data and user experience.
* Short decision paths: Work close to product, architecture and operations in a focused technology company where good ideas can quickly become improvements.
* Real\-world use: Work on a platform supporting active energy\-market operations across several countries.
* Continuous learning: Develop your expertise in cloud\-native software, DevSecOps and energy\-market technology.

**What we offer**


* Competitive compensation and bonus scheme.
* Flexible working arrangements.
* Modern offices in Oslo/Lysaker.
* Professional development opportunities and certifications.
* The opportunity to work with highly experienced developers and energy\-market specialists.
* Meaningful influence on products and technology choices.
* International and collaborative work environment.

**Location and working environment**


You will be based at our office in Oslo/Lysaker.


We value regular office collaboration and also acknowledge the value of facilitating flexibility related to working from home or remotely.


NODES is an Equal Opportunities Employer; we believe in fair treatment of all our employees and commit to promoting diversity in our employment practices.


We do not discriminate in employment based on race, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, political affiliation, disability, age, marital status, medical history, parental status, or genetic information.

Our award\-winning market platform is helping speed up the energy transition by unlocking the value of flexibility within the electricity network.


At NODES, we develop cloud\-native systems that help electricity grids use flexibility more efficiently, enabling more renewable energy and reducing the need for costly grid expansion.


Our platforms are already operating in multiple European countries and Canada, and we continue to expand.
